main.description: Dive sites whose current name contains q, ignoring case, best match first: the whole name, then names starting with q, then names with a word starting with q, then the rest; within a match, nearest the given centre first, or by name without one. Serves the sites searchDiveSites would serve the viewer. With a box, only sites whose centre lies in it. Keep paging while there is a cursor.

q.description: Search text, case-insensitive. A blank query returns no sites.

minLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The box is optional, but all four of its sides or none.

nearLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The centre results are ordered from within a match, with nearLng or not at all.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Only some of the box's sides, or only one of nearLat and nearLng; a box with min above max, or wider than 1 degree on either side.
